ok I am so pissed right now and I need you guys to do something for me.

a sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co is selling my switchblade moth. the one off my september flash sheet. they have it listed as "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal", $6.50 or 3 for $15. a friend sent me the listing tonight and I about threw my phone.

I drew that moth at my kitchen table for the sept 13 flash day. I posted the sheet august 30, scroll down, its still right there with the date on it. it was gone in the first hour.

and this is not "inspired by". its not "kinda similar". it is a straight scan of my linework. same crack in the blade. same wing pattern. they didnt even FLIP it. like at least pretend??

so I messaged them, told them its mine, told them I have the original drawing and the post, asked them to take it down. you wanna know what I got back? "Love your work." and then that their artists create original designs inspired by trending styles, that moths are "a very common tattoo motif", that they cant remove listings based on similarity alone, and if I have a registered copyright I can send it through their support form. have a great day!

love my work. yeah no kidding, youre selling it.

heres the part that actually makes me sick tho. flash gets sold ONE time to ONE person. thats the whole deal. you pick it off the sheet, its yours, I dont tattoo it on anybody else and I sure as hell dont print it on stickers. the person wearing that moth paid for exactly that. and tonight they messaged me asking if I was the one selling these. so now somebody who trusted me had to sit there wondering if I sold them out for six bucks a pop.

so to that person, you know who you are: it was not me. I have never sold that design to anybody but you and I'm not going to. what you paid for is still what you got, and I'm sorry you had to find out about this the way you did.

and these sticker places know exactly what theyre doing. they know small shops and people who draw for a living dont have lawyer money. thats the whole business model. tell the artist to go fill out a form and keep the printer running.

I literally posted last month about how I wont trace another artists work because its the one rule this whole industry agrees on. guess not everybody got the memo.

so heres what I'm asking. go look up StickerBurrow Co, find the Knife Moth Vinyl Decal, and report the listing. takes like a minute. and dont buy from them, not the moth, not anything. if they did it to me they did it to somebody else on there too. share this if you want, the more people reporting the better.

ok thats it. go report it. I'm gonna go scream into a pillow

reasons: It says the design was gone in the first hour, but not that the client was tattooed then.
